QUOTE: "`sanitizeReactions` returns `deleteReactions: []`. Without it, `deleteReactions` would be every stored reaction on the post not in the one-element list, so a single `reaction_added` would delete all other users' reactions."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly says skipSync stops the single reaction being treated as the full set, which would otherwise delete all other reactions on the post.
